name: occasion-shopify-theme
description: Occasion — supermarket / multipurpose Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme (source workspace: SCSS + vanilla JS).

scripts.dev: npm-run-all check:env sass:build -p sass:watch css:sync watch:img webpack serve
scripts.package: npm run build && shopify theme package
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && dotenv -- node scripts/shopify-theme-push.js
scripts.deploy:live: npm run build && dotenv -- node scripts/shopify-theme-push.js --live
scripts.theme:pull:live: echo WARNING: pull OVERWRITES local files with live shop theme. Press Ctrl+C to cancel. && dotenv -- shopify theme pull --live
